page_title: BOU 3-2 LIV | Bournemouth v Liverpool 24/01/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The match has just finished.
90+5' 3 - 2 Goal! Amine Adli (Bournemouth) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball into the left side of the goal. It's 3:2.
90+4' James Hill (Bournemouth) sends the ball into the penalty area from a throw-in as if it's a corner kick.
90+3' The referee is firm and issues Ryan Gravenberch (Liverpool) a deserved yellow card.
90+3' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
90+3' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Enes Unal (Bournemouth) replaces Evanilson.

90+2' Florian Wirtz (Liverpool) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Liverpool.
90+2' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) serves up a nice cross, but Djordje Petrovic punches the ball away.
90+1' The ball is cleared after Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
89' Good defending. Curtis Jones (Liverpool) tries to find Hugo Ekitike inside the box, but the pass is cut out.
88' The actual number of corner kicks in this match – 3:10.
87' Alex Scott (Bournemouth) makes some space for himself and from mid-range let's fly with a wild effort which goes high over the crossbar.
85' Golden chance! Florian Wirtz (Liverpool) meets a cross in the box and finds some space for a shot. He produces an inaccurate effort that goes wide of the left post.
85' Alejandro Jimenez will be replaced by Alex Toth (Bournemouth).
84' Evanilson (Bournemouth) doesn't hesitate to shoot inside the box after a neat pass from Ryan Christie. It's a good effort but just misses the left post.
82' The resulting corner from Lewis Cook (Bournemouth) comes to nothing.

81' Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) had a great opportunity from mid-range. His powerful volley was directed under the crossbar, but Alisson was alert and made an astonishing save! The linesman makes the right call and Bournemouth will have a corner.

80' 2 - 2 Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) struck with a perfectly taken free kick from the edge of the box. He curled the ball straight inside the right post. There are not enough superlatives that can be used to describe that goal.

79' Alejandro Jimenez (Bournemouth) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Michael Salisbury blows his whistle for a foul. Liverpool earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
78' Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) attempts to find his teammate with a final pass from outside of the box, but one of the defenders clears the ball to safety.
78' Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play.
77' Rio Ngumoha (Liverpool) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out.
74' Substitution. Cody Gakpo did his best and is replaced by Rio Ngumoha (Liverpool).
72' That was a wasted opportunity to score by Alejandro Jimenez (Bournemouth). He picks up the rebound and produces a poor effort which is easily saved by the goalkeeper.
72' The total number of attempts is 4:11. The shots on goal statistics – 2:2.
71' Alex Scott (Bournemouth) takes a mid-range free kick and the effort crashes into the defensive wall.

70' Hugo Ekitike (Liverpool) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Michael Salisbury no option but to blow his whistle. A free kick is awarded to Bournemouth.
69' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) launches a cross from the corner, but Djordje Petrovic is alert to thwart the effort.
68' Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared. The ball goes behind for a corner. Liverpool will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
67' Substitution. Eli Junior Kroupi will be replaced by Ryan Christie (Bournemouth).
66' Ryan Gravenberch (Liverpool) has an effort on goal, but he misses to the right of the goal.
66' Curtis Jones (Liverpool) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
65' James Hill (Bournemouth) has the ability to send the ball deep into the penalty area from throw-ins and it can lead to very promising situations for his team.
62' That looked a certain handball by Marcos Senesi (Bournemouth) inside the box, but the ref wasn't having it and just played on. NO penalty!
60' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
59' Arne Slot has decided to make a change. Curtis Jones (Liverpool) replaces Jeremie Frimpong.
59' The game has come to an end for Alexis Mac Allister. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Hugo Ekitike (Liverpool).
57' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) swings in the corner, but the goalkeeper does a brilliant job to intercept the effort.
55' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) sends in a poor cross from the corner and Djordje Petrovic has no trouble gathering it.

54' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The referee signals a corner kick to Liverpool.
54' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) has an effort from distance but it's blocked.
53' A pass by Jeremie Frimpong (Liverpool) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
52' Wataru Endo (Liverpool) threads a pass through to Cody Gakpo, but Djordje Petrovic breaks up the move.
49' Jeremie Frimpong (Liverpool) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety.
48' Ryan Gravenberch (Liverpool) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked.
47' Lewis Cook (Bournemouth) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates as he overhits the effort. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Liverpool.
46' Amine Adli (Bournemouth) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Arne Slot probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Milos Kerkez (Liverpool). He is replaced by Andrew Robertson.
46' The second half has just started.
45+4' The end of the first half.
45+4' A free kick into the box, taken by Mohamed Salah (Liverpool), is comfortably cleared by the opposition's defence.

45+3' Eli Junior Kroupi (Bournemouth) unnecessarily kicks the ball off the pitch. Eli Junior Kroupi (Bournemouth) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.

45+3' Amine Adli (Bournemouth) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Michael Salisbury stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning. A free kick has been awarded to Liverpool.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.

45' 2 - 1 Dominik Szoboszlai takes over corner duties and expertly finds Virgil van Dijk (Liverpool), who jumps highest and coolly plants a bullet header into the top right corner. The score is now 2:1.
45' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
45' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. Good work from Liverpool as they win a corner.

44' What an opportunity! Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) wastes a huge chance as he latches on to a perfect pass and produces a first-time blast from point blank range. It goes towards the right side of the goal, but Djordje Petrovic reacts superbly to keep the ball out.
43' Amine Adli (Bournemouth) plays a lovely through ball to Eli Junior Kroupi, but he can't beat Alisson and loses the ball.
41' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) sprays a pass out to Cody Gakpo, but he can't beat his man inside the box.
40' Florian Wirtz (Liverpool) tricks his way to the edge of the box where he shoots at goal. The keeper scrambles to cover the effort, but it goes just wide of the left post.
39' Evanilson (Bournemouth) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
37' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Florian Wirtz (Liverpool) takes it short.
37' Florian Wirtz (Liverpool) plays a one-two with Jeremie Frimpong, but the move breaks down. The linesman points to the corner flag, Liverpool are going to take it.
37' Amine Adli (Bournemouth) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates.
35' Here comes the VAR verdict: Referee Michael Salisbury signals that there was no offside and the goal stands! The Bournemouth players celebrate.
34' Wait! Referee Michael Salisbury has indicated he is going to review the Bournemouth goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
34' Joe Gomez doesn't have to suffer any longer with the painful injury as Wataru Endo (Liverpool) comes onto the pitch to replace him.
33' 2 - 0 Goal! A great through ball by James Hill sets up Alejandro Jimenez (Bournemouth) inside the box, and he makes no mistake and bangs the ball into the bottom left corner. 2:0.

32' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender. A pass from Milos Kerkez (Liverpool) is intercepted by Djordje Petrovic and the move breaks down.
31' 2:1 – the total goal attempt statistics. 1:0 – this is the current number of shots on target.
31' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
30' Joe Gomez (Liverpool) looks like he won’t be able to continue.
27' Joe Gomez (Liverpool) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.

26' 1 - 0 It's a goal! Evanilson (Bournemouth) shows off his superb ability as he volleys the ball from inside the box into the bottom left corner. The assist goes to Alex Scott and the score changes to 1:0.
25' Amine Adli (Bournemouth) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Liverpool.
25' Joe Gomez (Liverpool) fails to find a teammate across the pitch with a long ball.
25' James Hill (Bournemouth) sends a long ball in, but Alisson comfortably gathers the ball.
24' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) and Florian Wirtz try to prise open the opposition with a series of short passes, but one of the defenders steps in and puts an end to the move.
23' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.

23' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) attempts to find Florian Wirtz with a delicate little through ball from inside the box, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention. The referee blows his whistle, Liverpool are awarded a corner kick.
21' Djordje Petrovic leaps to collect the ball from the corner which was sent over by Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool).
20' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) takes the resulting corner which is well defended. The ball goes out of play. Liverpool are awarded a corner kick.
19' Florian Wirtz (Liverpool) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. Liverpool force a corner. They send men into the box.
18' The corner kick is deflected to James Hill (Bournemouth), who immediately sends in a long-range shot. However, he hits the ball poorly and it goes high over the bar.
18' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Lewis Cook (Bournemouth), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
17' Amine Adli (Bournemouth) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. Bournemouth force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
16' The percentage of ball possession is – 33:67.
16' Amine Adli (Bournemouth) sends over a free kick from long range but the defence is alert.
13' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.

10' Mohamed Salah latches onto a perfect defence-splitting pass from Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) and heads towards goal. Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared.
8' Alejandro Jimenez (Bournemouth) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger.
6' A precise low pass is received by Mohamed Salah (Liverpool), who makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box, but his poorly placed shot sails well wide of the left post.

4' Evanilson (Bournemouth) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Michael Salisbury blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion. Liverpool have a free kick.
4' A pass by Amine Adli (Bournemouth) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
3' Liverpool seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
2' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) sends a long ball forward to Mohamed Salah, but he put too much power and the chance is gone. The ball goes out of play and Bournemouth will have a goal kick.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
